features.name: deletion_vectors
features.rationale: Row-level soft deletes; pins the table to a modern protocol - older readers fail.

features.name: column_mapping
features.rationale: Rename/drop columns without rewriting data files.

features.name: liquid_clustering
features.rationale: Replaces static partitioning; incompatible with partitionBy on clustered keys.

features.name: cdf
features.rationale: Emits change records per commit; storage overhead proportional to churn.

features.name: schema_evolution
features.rationale: Widens schema on write - convenience at the cost of silent drift.
